purpose: Prevent verified Builder work from existing only in ephemeral execution workspaces.
rules: At 4 implementation passes a cumulative recovery checkpoint is DUE.
At 6 implementation passes a cumulative recovery checkpoint is MANDATORY and no further implementation pass may start until it is durably uploaded and read-back verified.
Any execution-environment reset, workspace remount, permission-mode change, or missing prior worktree triggers an immediate RECOVERY_BARRIER before new implementation.

A RECOVERY_BARRIER resolves the latest durable checkpoint, reconstructs a writable worktree, reruns validation, creates a new cumulative checkpoint when recovered work exceeds the durable checkpoint, uploads it, and verifies read-back metadata.
Temporary /mnt/data worktrees are caches, never authoritative recovery state.
A checkpoint is durable only after SHA256 calculation, ZIP integrity verification, Library upload receipt, and Library read-back verification.
Builder must record checkpoint file_id, library_file_id, path, SHA256, pass range, validated base and test result before continuing.

If a user explicitly requests delta-queue placement, the recovery artifact may be copied there but must be marked RECOVERY_ONLY / NOT_PRODUCTION_MERGE_INPUT unless it is a valid CUMULATIVE_SUBGOAL_FINAL.
Final convergence still requires a CUMULATIVE_SUBGOAL_FINAL independently applicable from the validated current canonical base.
